scope: Prepared finalization logic only; no runtime release, publication, cleanup, lock release or native completion authority.

findings.finding: The claimed retained score is checked only for arithmetic consistency against current status categories. It is not compared to the original root-reviewed plan categories and total, allowing an internally consistent changed score to be described as retained without reassessment.
findings.required: Before any mutation, require all ten current categories and total to equal the original reviewed score. Add a negative same-total category-redistribution control.

positiveFindings: The two-cycle publication sequence is bounded; final containing observation remains private and does not require another context publication.
Actual first release, first tested publication, persisted signed Ark and initial owned cleanup precede final clarification.
The original partial SIL checkpoint is preserved through append-only clarification.
Final clarification requires its own exact staged-tree native Studio verification and separate owned worktree cleanup.
Post-test descendants are limited to individually reviewed reports/audits receipt paths.
Receipt workflows are observed with complete paginated runs/jobs/steps and rerun detection; cancellation is a terminal disposition, never positive candidate CI credit.
Native completion remains separate from durable records and requires exact original goal/lock, fresh live/remote/census observations and positive technical candidate CI.
limitations: Actual production and full release acceptance remain unproven at review time.
Root must independently review the actual bound plans, native ledger coverage and observations before execution.
Synthetic controls do not prove native Studio, runtime delivery or completion.
